Below is a description of the bug and two small patches to change the default ratio from 1.5 to 1 in ImageArcGISRest. This will avoid the extra scaling that, when combined with browser or OS zoom/pixelRatio ≠ 1, causes image‐to‐map mis‐alignment and rotation glitches.

Bug root cause
- By default `ratio` was set to 1.5.  
- The code also applies `pixelRatio` (e.g. 1.5 at 150% zoom), so the total expansion of the requested image becomes `ratio * pixelRatio` (2.25 when both are 1.5), leading to the layer being oversized and misaligned.  
- Setting `ratio` to 1 removes that unintended extra extent expansion.

=======

With these two tiny edits, the default behavior will request images at exactly the viewport size (ratio = 1), avoiding the mismatches experienced at non‐100% device or browser scaling.
